changes.S05: Added shared semantic calendar-event validation used by domain creation/editing and backup restoration. It checks known company or null, supported type, title/detail limits, real ordered dates, and existing linked task in the same company. Edit revalidates its linked task's current access before producing notices. Invalid input is rejected before state or notice changes. Editing after author deactivation or company-scope revocation preserves the historical author reference, while visibility still uses current authorization; inactive profiles receive no new notice. Sol functionally accepted S05 after independent recheck of edit and cancellation paths.
changes.S15: Operational-rate panel supports explicit choice between catalogue template and a punctual operational task. Task choices are filtered by selected company and display task, company, month, and unit; commit sends taskId and immutable rate version. Domain and backup validation now require exactly one source (template XOR task); ambiguous rates are rejected. Sol independently accepted visible company/task alignment and version restore behavior.
changes.S20: Improvement-process date validation now uses the shared strict Gregorian validDate. Impossible trial/review/completion/measurement dates are rejected. Backup semantic validation checks measuredOn is a real day inside the trial interval and measuredBy is an existing profile; malformed or partial attribution is rejected. Valid date-only periods and ART catalogue effective dates remain intact. Sol functionally accepted S20.
changes.S24: Opening a calendar obligation revalidates current actor visibility, selects that obligation's fiscal period only inside the fiscal module, expands the source panel, and focuses/scrolls the original record after it is visible. Missing or revoked origins show a notice. Scroll respects prefers-reduced-motion. Regression covers a folded panel and an obligation whose fiscal period differs from its due month, while the calendar month remains unchanged. GPT-6.1 Sol independently accepted S24; its focused probes passed 12/12, including missing origin and revoked actor.
changes.S25: NotificationCenter schedules one timer to next ART midnight, refreshes on focus/visibility, keeps closed badge current and recomputes IDs/cutoff when marking read. Timer/listeners clean up and no per-second writes. Independent Sol accepted functionally with 6/6 probes: ART rollover/year boundary, resume, read receipt, actor change, StrictMode timer/listener cleanup.
changes.remaining_stage_4: S05/S15/S20/S24/S25/S33/S40/S41/S42/S48 accepted functionally. S52 implementation and local/browser verification are complete; independent Sol review remains open.
changes.S33: ParameterizationInbox removes operational quotas and no longer writes operational targets or legacy weights. Deliverable weights remain editable; operational movement coefficients remain separately versioned. Laboratory domain allows operational-only review without values and preserves targets/snapshots. Failure to persist leaves the dialog open and notifies. The operational Worker/site-policy and Supabase contracts are unchanged.
changes.S40: New fiscal obligations use evaluationVersion 2 and accept only verifiable result tasks from the same company. Legacy unversioned obligations keep their historical target interpretation; old operational links remain visible as historical during editing and cannot be newly added. Backup validation preserves v1/unversioned history and makes an unmarked history revision inherit its parent evaluation version, preventing a v2 revision from bypassing result-only links. Sol accepted after 37/37 independent probes; regression accepts valid unmarked v2 history and rejects the same record when changed to an operational task.
changes.S41: OperationalRatePanel initializes its effective date with dateART and does not replace a date already selected in an open form. Tests cover ART midnight boundaries across UTC date rollover, a simulated Pacific/Kiritimati local browser zone, year rollover, and a same-day movement snapshot applying the coefficient. Sol accepted functionally with 50/50 independent probes.
changes.S42: Task notifications compare availability, normalized dependency sets, and commercial tracking. One generic changed notice is emitted per authorized recipient for combined changes; completion/assignment/joint precedence stays intact. Null/absent equivalence, dependency reorder/deduplication, disabled tracking, revoked recipient, preserved read receipts, no-op/timer changes, and failed persistence were independently checked. Sol accepted functionally with 18/18 probes.
changes.S48: Sol accepted S48 functionally. New result-point aggregation excludes legacy operational weights; movement counts, quantities, time, joint quotas, and historic snapshots remain available. Onboarding clarifies that operations are measured by movements/time and that coefficients are configured by management. A coefficient is not created by approving a proposal.
changes.S52: Implemented and browser-verified with real Recharts: lab analytics retain task-bearing groups independent of deliverable points; operational-only groups appear on the category axis and a note identifies them as “Sin base de entregables”; a real zero-deliverable group is listed separately under “Cumplimiento 0%”. Exported CSV distinguishes no basis, numeric zero and “Sin evaluar”. Focused integration/export tests pass.
